question: A ring oscillator of 3, 5, 7 cells: is the period 2 x cells ticks?
apparatus: odd ring of NOT cells, read period
did: Built rings of 3, 5 and 7 cells, each lit unless the one before it was lit a tick earlier. No inputs. Read every cell for 8 x cells ticks and found the shortest repeat.
observed: 3 cells: period 2 (expected 6); first ticks 000 111 000 111 000; 5 cells: period 2 (expected 10); first ticks 00000 11111 00000 11111 00000; 7 cells: period 2 (expected 14); first ticks 0000000 1111111 0000000 1111111 0000000
shows: It does not. Every cell starts HOME at tick 0, so they all see the same thing and all flip together: the ring beats as one, period 2, whatever its length. A travelling wave needs the symmetry broken by an input.
